name: SuperDashboard
desc:
SuperDashboard: a configurable dashboard reached from a floating bubble or the toolbar. Configurable sections: shortcuts (folders, notes, pdf, ...), a little file browser, name search (with a small query grammar), recent files, stars, keywords, a clock, device status (battery / free storage / stats), app launchers, and Note Clips. Several choices of designs and organisations, font (including MyStyle fonts) and text size.

Note Clips: lasso any part of a note and tap "Clip to Dashboard" to pin it as a labelled thumbnail; tap it to jump back to its source page, or paste it into any note with a link back to the source. Keep clips as handwriting or OCR them to text (each block shows handwriting, text or both), and paste an OCR'd clip as an editable text box with a font and size of your choice. Underline a word with the straight-line tool and it becomes the clip's label automatically. Backlinks follow the source page even if you reorder it or move it to another note. Clips show as collapsible cards with a live label filter; sort and group by note, filter by folder or label, size the thumbnails, and optionally mark the captured area on the note.

Clock: 12/24-hour, optional date, ISO or US week number, several faces (including a 7-segment "Digital" style), and extra time zones you dial in with +/- offsets from local time.

Fully offline (no internet). Needs file access: READ to scan notes for stars/keywords, browse/open files and capture clips; WRITE to save its own settings, to paste a clip into a note, and (only when you turn it on) draw the clip frame on your note. Deleting a star or a clip is always an explicit tap.

Source & updates: https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard; Support the plugin: https://ko-fi.com/agp42
